Buffer: A fixed-length view of binary data, backed by an `ArrayBuffer` and extending `Uint8Array`.
Buffer.constructor: Create a `Buffer` viewing `arrayBuffer`, optionally starting at `offset` for `length` bytes.
Buffer.alloc: Allocate a new, zero-filled `Buffer` of `size` bytes, optionally filled with `fill`.
Buffer.allocUnsafe: Allocate a new `Buffer` of `size` bytes without zeroing its contents first.
Buffer.allocUnsafeSlow: Allocate a new `Buffer` of `size` bytes without zeroing its contents first, bypassing the internal buffer pool.
Buffer.atob: Decode a base64-encoded string into a Latin-1 binary string.
Buffer.btoa: Encode a Latin-1 binary string into a base64 string.
Buffer.BufferEncoding: The set of encodings supported by `Buffer` methods that convert between bytes and strings.
Buffer.byteLength: Return the number of bytes `string` would occupy once encoded as `encoding`.
Buffer.coerce: Return `buffer` unchanged if it is already a `Buffer`, otherwise wrap its underlying `ArrayBuffer` in a new `Buffer`.
Buffer.concat: Concatenate `buffers` into a single new `Buffer`, optionally truncated or zero-padded to `length`.
Buffer.constants: Limits for buffers and strings: `MAX_LENGTH` (largest possible `Buffer`) and `MAX_STRING_LENGTH` (largest possible string).
Buffer.copyBytesFrom: Copy the bytes of `view`, starting at `offset` for `length` elements, into a new `Buffer`.
Buffer.from: Create a new `Buffer` from an array, array-like, string, or `ArrayBuffer`.
Buffer.isAscii: Check whether `buffer` contains only valid ASCII-encoded data.
Buffer.isASCII: Check whether `buffer` contains only valid ASCII-encoded data.
Buffer.isUtf8: Check whether `buffer` contains only valid UTF-8-encoded data.
Buffer.isUTF8: Check whether `buffer` contains only valid UTF-8-encoded data.
Buffer.poolSize: The size, in bytes, of the internal buffer pool used to satisfy small allocations.
Buffer.transcode: Re-encode `buffer` from one encoding to another, returning a new `Buffer`.
Buffer.compare: Compare two buffers' contents lexicographically, returning -1, 0, or 1 for sort ordering.
Buffer.copy: Copy bytes from this buffer into `target`, returning the number of bytes copied.
Buffer.equals: Check whether this buffer and `target` have identical contents.
Buffer.fill: Fill this buffer with `value`, repeating as needed, and return it.
Buffer.indexOf: Return the first index at which `value` occurs in this buffer, or `-1` if not found.
Buffer.lastIndexOf: Return the last index at which `value` occurs in this buffer, or `-1` if not found.
Buffer.readBigInt64BE: Read a signed 64-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readBigInt64LE: Read a signed 64-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readBigUint64BE: Read an unsigned 64-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readBigUInt64BE: Read an unsigned 64-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readBigUint64LE: Read an unsigned 64-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readBigUInt64LE: Read an unsigned 64-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readInt16BE: Read a signed 16-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readInt16LE: Read a signed 16-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readInt32BE: Read a signed 32-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readInt32LE: Read a signed 32-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readIntBE: Read a signed, big-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readIntLE: Read a signed, little-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUint16BE: Read an unsigned 16-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUInt16BE: Read an unsigned 16-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUint16LE: Read an unsigned 16-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUInt16LE: Read an unsigned 16-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUint32BE: Read an unsigned 32-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUInt32BE: Read an unsigned 32-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUint32LE: Read an unsigned 32-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUInt32LE: Read an unsigned 32-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUintBE: Read an unsigned, big-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUIntBE: Read an unsigned, big-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUintLE: Read an unsigned, little-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.readUIntLE: Read an unsigned, little-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.swap16: Swap the byte order of each 16-bit group in this buffer in place, and return it.
Buffer.swap32: Swap the byte order of each 32-bit group in this buffer in place, and return it.
Buffer.swap64: Swap the byte order of each 64-bit group in this buffer in place, and return it.
Buffer.toJSON: Return an array of this buffer's bytes, used when the buffer is passed to `JSON.stringify()`.
Buffer.toString: Decode this buffer (or a slice of it) to a string using `encoding`.
Buffer.write: Write `string` into this buffer using `encoding`, returning the number of bytes written.
Buffer.writeBigInt64BE: Write a signed 64-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeBigInt64LE: Write a signed 64-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeBigUint64BE: Write an unsigned 64-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeBigUInt64BE: Write an unsigned 64-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeBigUint64LE: Write an unsigned 64-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeBigUInt64LE: Write an unsigned 64-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeInt16BE: Write a signed 16-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeInt16LE: Write a signed 16-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeInt32BE: Write a signed 32-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeInt32LE: Write a signed 32-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeIntBE: Write a signed, big-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeIntLE: Write a signed, little-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUint16BE: Write an unsigned 16-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUInt16BE: Write an unsigned 16-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUint16LE: Write an unsigned 16-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUInt16LE: Write an unsigned 16-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUint32BE: Write an unsigned 32-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUInt32BE: Write an unsigned 32-bit big-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUint32LE: Write an unsigned 32-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUInt32LE: Write an unsigned 32-bit little-endian integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUintBE: Write an unsigned, big-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUIntBE: Write an unsigned, big-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUintLE: Write an unsigned, little-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
Buffer.writeUIntLE: Write an unsigned, little-endian, `byteLength`-byte integer at `offset`.
